L'idée est née d'un constat simple : les: The idea came from a simple observation: large groups have entire teams to read their numbers, while SMEs get one set of year-end accounts a year. Vyzor aims to give SME business owners the same insight, without the team. During the beta, early users talk directly to the founders:
La comptabilité d'une PME contient l'ess: An SME's books hold most of what it takes to run the business, but they remain hard to read for anyone outside the profession. Vyzor analyzes the company's past, sheds light on its present and projects its financial future, so the business owner can make decisions with clear numbers, without waiting for the year-end accounts.
